newsitem.title: USA: HCIA to buy Equifax health unit.
newsitem.headline: HCIA to buy Equifax health unit.

text.p: HCIA Inc said on Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to buy Equifax Inc's health analytical services unit for $11.5 million in cash.
This unit provides decision support services for medical care providers and payors through physician profiling and medical claims review systems, HCIA said.
The transaction was expected to close in mid December, the company said.

George D. Pillari, chairman and chief executive officer of HCIA, said: "The acquisition complements the development of MCO.SYS, HCIA's recently announced product that is targeted at managed care organizations." It also gave HCIA several new managed care customers, he said.
Equifax said the sale was part of its previously announced decision to exit the health information field and focus on its core financial and insurance services.
